item_short_desc: Celebrate your passion for space exploration with Rothco’s NASA Low Pro Cap. This stylish black low-profile cap features the iconic NASA meatball patch, making it a must-have for space enthusiasts. Made from 100% brushed cotton twill, the baseball cap is designed for durability and comfort. The adjustable hook & loop closure at the back ensures a perfect fit for most head sizes, while the inner sweatband helps keep you cool and dry during wear.
